//: The scripts are plain Node TypeScript, run through --experimental-strip-types, not React Native.
Checked for the same reason the tests are: `npm run report:books` had been broken for weeks by a rename
in src/, and nothing noticed, because scripts/ was in no tsconfig at all.
`module: esnext` rather than `nodenext`, which is what tests/ uses. Node runs these as ESM because it
detects module syntax in them, but `nodenext` takes the format from package.json `type` instead — and
this package has none, so every top-level await became an error about a CommonJS module. Adding
`type: module` to package.json would settle it and would also change how Metro and every Expo config
file are loaded, which is a large bill for a build script.
